description: This source file defines the DelegatorEcaHandler class that implements EntityEcaHandler for handling Entity-Conditional Events in the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages ECA rules, fetches dispatch contexts asynchronously, and evaluates rules based on entity events.

classes.name: DelegatorEcaHandler
classes.description: Class responsible for handling entity event-condition-action rules in OFBiz, managing rule evaluation, and caching dispatch contexts.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Initializes the handler with a Delegator instance; preloads the ECA cache and sets up asynchronous dispatch context retrieval.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Retrieves the DispatchContext, waiting asynchronously if necessary, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: getEntityEventMap
methods.description: Returns the map of event types to rules for a given entity name.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates applicable ECA rules for a given entity event, current operation, and entity instance; respects the event map and logs verbose info.
